papers.title: Long-Term Care Insurance and Catastrophic Health Spending at the End of Life Among Older Adults: Evidence From China.
papers.abstract: End-of-life (EOL) health spending imposes catastrophic financial burdens on elderly households, pushing them into poverty without corresponding improvements in health outcomes. Leveraging the quasi-experiment of China's public long-term care insurance (LTCI) pilot program, this study employs data from the China Longitudinal Healthy Longevity Survey to examine the impact of LTCI on catastrophic health spending (CHS) at the end of life. The findings indicate that over the 5-year EOL period, LTCI significantly decreases the probability of CHS by approximately 36.1-52.3 percentage points and reduces out-of-pocket health spending. Furthermore, the study demonstrates that LTCI reduces CHS without compromising EOL health by substituting aggressive medical interventions with sustained long-term care support, which leads to fewer severe-illness episodes, shorter hospital stays, and reduced dependency. These findings provide empirical evidence for the role of LTCI in facilitating value-based healthcare at the end of life, with significant implications for establishing universal LTCI systems in China and other countries.
papers.summary: 本研究利用中國公共長期護理保險（LTCI）試點項目的準實驗與長壽縱向調查數據，探討LTCI對老年人生命末期（EOL）災難性醫療支出（CHS）的影響。研究發現，在生命末期5年內，LTCI不僅顯著降低約36.1至52.3個百分點的CHS發生機率及自付醫療費用，且未損害EOL健康狀態。這是因為LTCI以持續的長期照護替代了激進的醫療干預，進而減少了重症發作次數、縮短住院時間並降低失能依賴。
papers.significance: 此研究為LTCI在促進生命末期「價值導向醫療」方面的作用提供了關鍵的實證支持，證明LTCI能有效避免老年家庭因病致貧。該結論對中國及其他正面臨高齡化挑戰的國家在建立或完善全民長期護理保險體系方面，具有極高的政策參考價值與啟示。

papers.title: Strategic Delay and Bargaining Over Public Insurance Coverage for Drugs in Australia.
papers.abstract: Public funding for pharmaceuticals often follows repeated negotiation between manufacturers and a public agency, yet little empirical work examines how the timing of agreement reflects the economic structure of these interactions. Using a duration model of negotiations in Australia from 2005 to 2018, we assess whether observed patterns of delay and agreement align with dynamic bargaining theory under incomplete information. Agreements from 634 submissions for 400 therapies required a median of 16 months, and 71% of negotiation rounds ended without agreement. Therapies with lower expected value to the agency-reflected in higher incremental cost per QALY, greater budget impact, or evidence uncertainty-experienced longer delays and lower agreement rates, while those with strong clinical importance, perceived need, or elevated public interest were listed more quickly. Delays also varied across therapeutic classes and with a therapy's position in the sequencing of available treatments. The observed patterns point to a systematic listing rule in which therapies are funded when expected health gains justify their opportunity costs. They also support the view that the timing of agreement reflects strategic negotiation under uncertainty, not simply procedural delay.
papers.summary: 本研究利用2005至2018年澳洲藥品保險談判的持續期模型，探討協議達成的時機是否符合不完全資訊下的動態議價理論。研究發現，400種療法的634項申請中位耗時16個月，且71%的談判回合未能達成協議。對公共機構預期價值較低的藥品（如每QALY增量成本高、預算衝擊大或證據具不確定性）面臨更長的延遲與更低的成功率；反之，具高臨床重要性、需求度高或受公眾關注的藥品則能更快納入保險。此外，延遲時間亦因治療類別與藥品在治療序列中的位置而異。
papers.significance: 此研究為公共藥品保險的議價過程提供了重要的實證證據，證實延遲並非單純的行政程序問題，而是不確定性下的策略性議價結果。其揭示了系統性規律：僅當預期健康收益足以證明其機會成本合理時，藥品才會獲得資金。此發現有助於決策者與藥企理解談判機制，並為優化藥品補貼制度及資源配置提供理論支持。

papers.title: Accounting for the Opportunity Cost of Children's Time in Economic Evaluation: Challenges and Frequently Asked Questions.
papers.abstract: Economic evaluations carried out from a societal perspective ought to account for the opportunity cost of a range of resources, including those committed by care recipients. People's time is such a resource: it is limited, valuable and it has an opportunity cost that should be reflected in cost calculations. Yet, when it comes to children and young people (CYP), there are few suggestions on how to value their time and include it in economic evaluations. Despite repeated calls for research, this remains a persistent gap in our methodology "playbook". In this paper, we look at the topic by bringing together seminal literature and recent research findings. We discuss key uncertainties that need to be resolved for the topic to move forwards, outline challenges and "frequently asked questions", offer our views on possible answers and solutions, and sketch out a roadmap for future research.
papers.summary: 本文探討如何在社會視角的經濟評估中計算兒童與青少年（CYP）時間的機會成本。儘管時間是一種有限且有價值的資源，但現行方法論對於如何評估兒童時間並將其納入成本計算缺乏明確指引。作者透過梳理基礎文獻與最新研究，剖析推進此領域所需解決的關鍵不確定性，回應常見挑戰與問題，並提出未來研究的發展路線圖。
papers.significance: 該研究填補了健康經濟學評估方法論中的長期空白。明確納入兒童時間的機會成本，有助於提升社會視角經濟評估的完整性和準確性，避免低估兒童相關醫療或社會干預措施的真實資源消耗，從而為決策者提供更科學、可靠的資源分配依據。

papers.title: Paying for Health Gains Using Patient Reported Outcome Measures.
papers.abstract: Payments to healthcare providers are often based on the number of patients with a particular diagnosis or treatment with well known limitations. Payment based on health outcomes, a form of pay-for-performance, has long been advocated as a possible solution. We use a contract theory approach and illustrate how it can inform practical implementation of pay-for-performance schemes that reward health outcomes. The pricing rule suggests that the bonus should be set to reflect the difference between the provider's marginal cost of a health improvement before the policy intervention and the provider's marginal cost evaluated at the target health set by the purchaser. We provide estimates of the optimal bonus for hip and knee replacement under a range of assumptions about provider cost functions and the value of health improvements.
papers.summary: 本文探討如何基於健康結果（如患者報告結果指標）來支付醫療提供者報酬，以解決傳統按診斷或治療數量計費的局限性。研究採用契約理論，提出一種按績效付費方案的定價規則：獎金應設定為反映政策干預前提供者提升健康的邊際成本，與購買者設定目標健康水準下之邊際成本的差額。此外，研究在多種提供者成本函數與健康改善價值的假設下，針對髖關節與膝關節置換手術提供了最優獎金的具體估算。
papers.significance: 此研究為實施「按價值付費」的醫療政策提供了堅實的理論基礎與實務計算框架。透過明確定義獎金與邊際成本的關係，它解決了長期困擾政策制定者的績效獎勵定價難題，有助於推動醫療體系從「量」向「質」轉變，確保資源被更有效地用於實實在在提升患者的健康結果。

papers.title: The Financial and Behavioral Effects of Free Prescription Drugs: Evidence From a Policy Discontinuity in Poland.
papers.abstract: We examine whether a universal drug subsidy for seniors in Poland provided effective financial protection and whether it induced ex ante moral hazard. The policy eliminated out-of-pocket costs for prescription medications while leaving all other healthcare coverage unchanged. Using detailed household expenditure data and a sharp age-based eligibility threshold, we implement a difference-in-discontinuities design to estimate causal effects. The reform reduced average medication spending and lowered the incidence of catastrophic drug expenditures by 62%, with gains concentrated in the upper tail of the spending distribution-consistent with insurance against large health shocks. On the non-medical margin, we find suggestive evidence of a modest increase in spending on a category of unhealthy goods-consistent with reduced precautionary behavior at the household level. These results highlight that while public subsidies can meaningfully reduce financial risk, they may also induce behavioral responses that partially offset intended health benefits.
papers.summary: 本研究探討波蘭針對長者的免費處方藥政策是否提供有效的財務保護，以及是否引發事前道德風險。利用家庭支出資料與年齡資格門檻的差異斷點設計，研究發現該政策顯著降低平均藥物支出，並將災難性藥物支出發生率降低62%，主要收益集中在高支出群體，顯示其具有防範重大健康衝擊的保險功能。然而，在非醫療支出方面，研究也發現不健康商品支出有輕微增加，表明家庭層面的預防性行為可能有所減少。
papers.significance: 此研究為公共醫療補貼政策的評估提供了重要的因果證據。其核心意義在於揭示了一個權衡：雖然免除自付費用的補貼能切實降低長者的財務風險與災難性支出，但伴隨而來的預防性行為下降（事前道德風險）可能會部分抵消預期的健康效益。這對未來制定與優化醫療保障政策具有重要的政策參考價值。

papers.title: Time and amount attributes exert distinct neural influences on gain and loss evaluation.
papers.abstract: People typically discount delayed gains more than delayed losses, reflecting a gain-loss asymmetry. This event-related potential study examined how neural representations of amount and time, two prominent attributes in delay discounting, are influenced by contextual valence (gains vs. losses) through the lens of neural dynamics. Forty participants performed a simple guessing task in which they experienced a gain context with varying reward amounts delivered at different time delays, and a loss context with varying loss amounts delivered similarly. Time and amount attributes were manipulated orthogonally and parametrically. Results showed that in the gain context, time attribute was first tracked during the reward positivity (RewP) period, then integrated with linearly-increasing monetary value during the P3 period, and finally processed independently from monetary value during the late positive potential (LPP) period. In the loss context, time was similarly processed during the RewP period, whereas monetary value was not tracked until the LPP period. Additionally, a correlation between behavioral and neural delay discounting was found in the loss but not gain context. Our findings demonstrate distinct evaluative processes for time and amount attributes between gain and loss contexts, providing new insights into the gain-loss asymmetry in delay discounting.
papers.summary: 本研究透過事件相關電位（ERP）探討跨期貼現中時間與金額屬性在收益與損失情境下的神經處理差異。結果發現，在收益情境中，時間訊號於RewP時期被初步追蹤，並在P3時期與金額價值整合，最後在LPP時期獨立處理；而在損失情境中，時間雖在RewP時期有類似處理，但金額價值直到LPP時期才被追蹤。此外，行為與神經層面的跨期貼現相關性僅存在於損失情境中，顯示大腦對收益與損失的時間與金額評估具有截然不同的動態過程。
papers.significance: 此研究從神經動力學角度揭示了跨期貼現中「收益-損失不對稱性」的底層認知機制，證實大腦處理時間延遲與金額大小的過程會因情境效價（得與失）而產生不同路徑。這不僅深化了對非理性決策的科學理解，對於金融市場中投資者面對獲利與虧損時的風險偏好與時間偏好異象，也提供了全新的神經科學解釋視角，有助於未來發展更精準的行為金融預測模型。
